popCulture.title: Androgeos
popCulture.description: Son of Minos murdered in Attica — the death that brings the Athenian tribute of youths to the Minotaur. Not every Androgeos of the Trojan catalogues.

popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: Androgeus' murder is the grievance behind Minos' demand — the mythic hinge that sends Theseus into the Labyrinth.
